name.pt-BR: Padre Brown: Duas Histórias Não Coletadas

description.en-US: Two Father Brown stories that belong to none of the five collections: The Donnington Affair (1914, written with Max Pemberton for The Premier) and The Mask of Midas (written in 1936, first printed long after).
description.pt-BR: Duas histórias do Padre Brown que não pertencem a nenhuma das cinco coletâneas: O Caso Donnington (1914, escrita com Max Pemberton para a The Premier) e A Máscara de Midas (escrita em 1936 e impressa muito depois).

sources.edition: The Donnington Affair (The Premier, November 1914; with Max Pemberton) and The Mask of Midas (written 1936), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks13/1301541h and ebooks13/1302281h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). The Donnington Affair was published in 1914; The Mask of Midas was written in 1936 and first printed later; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries both under Australian law.
